final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), cross_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) AS average_of_average_unit_prices, AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(bytes_per_millisecond - avg_rate) AS average_rate_above_cross_media_average FROM media_rates CROSS JOIN cross_avg WHERE bytes_per_millisecond > avg_rate
